item.title: RRP’s Aftercare Industry Month Virtual Conference Returns for 2026
item.description: The Retired Racehorse Project (RRP) announced today the return of its popular Aftercare Industry Month (AIM) for February 2026, presented by Thoroughbred Education and Research Foundation (TERF). The post RRP’s Aftercare Industry Month Virtual Conference Returns for 2026 appeared first on Retired Racehorse Project.

item.title: Feeding Fat to Your Thoroughbred
item.description: Adding fat could benefit your horse. But with so many fat sources available, how do you decide which one is best? The post Feeding Fat to Your Thoroughbred appeared first on Retired Racehorse Project.

item.title: Retired Racehorse Project & Virginia Tech Team Up for Thoroughbred Wellness Expo
item.description: The Retired Racehorse Project (RRP) and Virginia Tech jointly announced today the Thoroughbred Wellness Expo, which will take place on Saturday, February 28, at Virginia Tech’s Marion duPont Scott Equine Medical Center in Leesburg, VA. The post Retired Racehorse Project & Virginia Tech Team Up for Thoroughbred Wellness Expo appeared first on Retired Racehorse Project.

item.title: Dental Care for Thoroughbreds
item.description: Make sure your Thoroughbred receives high-quality maintenance dentistry for optimal performance and comfort. The post Dental Care for Thoroughbreds appeared first on Retired Racehorse Project.

item.title: Accepted Trainers Announced for 2026 Thoroughbred Makeover
item.description: The Retired Racehorse Project (RRP) announced today the list of participating trainers accepted to compete at the 2026 Thoroughbred Makeover and National Symposium, presented by Thoroughbred Charities of America, taking place on October 7-10 at the Kentucky Horse Park in Lexington. The post Accepted Trainers Announced for 2026 Thoroughbred Makeover appeared first on Retired Racehorse Project.

item.title: 2026 Trainer Acceptance Letter
item.description: Congratulations! You are one of over 300 talented trainers and team members who are on track to show the world what a Thoroughbred ex-racehorse can do at this year’s Makeover. Would you like to announce your acceptance on social media? Download the official 2025 Accepted Trainer Badge here and share it on your socials with #TBMakeover! DON’T STOP READING HERE! The post 2026 Trainer Acceptance Letter appeared first on Retired Racehorse Project.

item.title: The Will to Try: Diving Into the Psychology of the Thoroughbred
item.description: Thoroughbreds bring sensitivity and drive to second careers. Clear, thoughtful training helps riders make the most of those traits. The post The Will to Try: Diving Into the Psychology of the Thoroughbred appeared first on Retired Racehorse Project.

item.title: Retired Racehorse Project Announces 2026-2030 Strategic Plan
item.description: The RRP announced today the unveiling of its new strategic plan, designed to expand support services, strengthen the Thoroughbred Makeover, and deepen collaboration across the racing, equestrian and aftercare sectors. The post Retired Racehorse Project Announces 2026-2030 Strategic Plan appeared first on Retired Racehorse Project.
